easy.def: A round house made of blocks of snow.
examples: The igloo is made of snow.
We built an igloo.
It was warm inside the igloo.

more.def: A dome-shaped shelter built from blocks of packed snow, once used by people in cold northern lands.
examples: Hunters built an igloo for shelter on the ice.
The children made a small igloo in the snow.
Snow blocks were stacked in a circle to form an igloo.

easy.def: Made from cooled lava or magma.
examples: Igneous rock.
Granite is igneous.
The igneous stone.

more.def: Formed from cooled lava or magma, said of rock.
examples: Granite is an igneous rock.
Igneous rocks come from volcanoes.
The cliff was made of igneous rock.

related.def: The start of burning, or what starts a car.

examples: Dry leaves can ignite.
The spark ignited the paper.
A match ignites.

more.def: To start burning, or to make something start burning.
examples: Dry leaves can ignite easily when a spark lands on them.
The spark ignited the paper and it burned quickly.
The grown-up used a match to ignite the campfire.
Ignorance can be fixed by learning.
He apologized for his ignorance.
Her ignorance was a surprise.

more.def: A lack of knowledge or information about something.
examples: Ignorance can be fixed by learning and reading.
He said sorry for his ignorance of the rules.
Her ignorance of the facts led to a mistake.
I was ignorant of the rules.
She is ignorant of the news.
The boy was ignorant.

more.def: Not having knowledge or information about something.
examples: I was ignorant of the new rule.
She was ignorant of the danger.
He was ignorant about how to use the machine.

easy.def: To not pay attention to something.
examples: Ignore the noise and keep reading.
The cat ignores me when I call.
Do not ignore the stop sign.

more.def: To pay no attention to someone or something on purpose.
examples: He ignored the ringing phone and finished his homework.
She ignored the teasing and kept playing.
If you ignore a small leak, it can become a big problem.

easy.def: A large green lizard with a long tail.
examples: We saw an iguana.
The iguana is green.
An iguana sat on the rock.

more.def: A large lizard with a long tail and a row of spikes down its back, found in warm places.
examples: An iguana sunned itself on the rock.
The green iguana climbed up the tree.
Iguanas eat leaves and fruit.
